title: Cell observation
description: One segmented cell in one logical image in one analysis run. All fields are present; nullable fields explicitly encode missing information. Cross-row and manifest constraints are in dataset_contract.json.

run_uid.description: UUID identifying this analysis run; measurements from different runs remain separate.

sequence_uid.description: Stable field-of-view/time-series UUID; tracking never crosses sequences automatically.

image_uid.description: Stable UUID for a logical multichannel image at one time point and analysis plane/volume.

cell_uid.description: Immutable UUID for a biological cell within the experiment. A division creates two new cell UIDs; the parent track ends.

observation_uid.description: Unique UUID for this cell observation in this run and image.

profile_id.description: Identifier and version of the saved imaging/import profile.

image_relative_path.description: Path to the source file relative to the dataset root; may represent a multichannel container.

series_index.description: Zero-based series index inside the source container.

frame_index.description: Zero-based time index within the sequence.

analysis_dimension.description: Whether the segmented object is measured in a 2D plane or 3D volume.

plane_index.description: Zero-based source Z plane for 2D plane analysis; null for volumes or projections.

acquired_at.description: Acquisition date and time in RFC3339 with explicit UTC offset. Null when unavailable; never substitute file modification time.

elapsed_time_s.description: Seconds since the first time point; may be known even if absolute acquisition time is unknown.

processed_at.description: Time this observation was generated, RFC3339 with UTC offset.

pixel_size_x_um.description: Physical sampling interval along x in micrometres; null if uncalibrated or inapplicable.

pixel_size_y_um.description: Physical sampling interval along y in micrometres; null if uncalibrated or inapplicable.

pixel_size_z_um.description: Physical sampling interval along z in micrometres; null if uncalibrated or inapplicable.

mask_relative_path.description: Saved labeled-mask path relative to the run output root.

mask_label.description: Positive integer uniquely identifying the object within this mask; zero is background.

cellprofiler_object_number.description: CellProfiler object number in its image/object set. Join through the verified mask mapping, never assume equal numbering.

cellprofiler_object_name.description: CellProfiler object set containing the segmented cell.

lineage_code.description: Human-readable code with origin prefix S=confirmed seeded, F=first-frame observed, D=daughter, E=entered field, U=unknown; e.g. S-L000001-G00-B000001. Descendants retain L and increment G, with sequence-wide unique B. Display metadata may change after lineage correction.

lineage_root_uid.description: Cell UID of the earliest observed ancestor, not necessarily the originally seeded cell.

parent_cell_uid.description: Immediate parent cell UID; null when absent or unknown.

generation.description: Number of observed divisions from the earliest observed ancestor, not absolute biological generation.

origin_status.description: Evidence-based origin; first_frame_observed does not imply seeded.

lineage_status.description: Evidence/review status of the current lineage assignment.

lineage_confidence.description: Calibrated probability for the proposed parent link, only if supplied by a validated method; otherwise null.

lineage_revision.description: Version of the lineage assignment; revisions preserve cell UIDs where identity is unchanged.

qc_status.description: Aggregate quality status. Unassessed is distinct from pass.

qc_flags.description: Machine-readable flags; empty means no recorded flags, not proof of passing QC.

measurement_status.description: Completion of CellProfiler measurements for this object.

features.description: All registered numeric CellProfiler measurements. Keys match the run feature dictionary. Null means unavailable; zero remains a measured zero.

death_probability.description: Predicted probability of death within death_prediction_horizon_h; null until a validated prediction is available.

death_prediction_horizon_h.description: Prediction horizon in hours from this observation.

predicted_death_phase.description: Predicted cell-cycle phase at death; null when unavailable. No phase is inferred merely from death probability.

prediction_model_id.description: Versioned prediction model identifier; required for any populated prediction.

tags.description: User-defined, namespaced annotations, such as user.treatment or model.future_score. Reserved fields cannot be overridden.

imaging_device_name.description: Instrument name recorded by the acquisition system. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.

imaging_device_manufacturer.description: Manufacturer of the imaging instrument. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.

imaging_device_model.description: Hardware model of the imaging instrument. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.

imaging_device_serial_number.description: Instrument serial number; preserve as text including leading zeros. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.

imaging_device_hardware_revision.description: Hardware revision of the imaging instrument. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.

imaging_device_firmware_version.description: Firmware version of the imaging instrument. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.

acquisition_software_name.description: Name/product of the software that acquired the image; separate from analysis software. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.

acquisition_software_version.description: Version of the acquisition software. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.

acquisition_software_build.description: Build identifier of the acquisition software. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.

camera_manufacturer.description: Manufacturer of the acquisition camera. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.

camera_model.description: Hardware model of the acquisition camera. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.

camera_serial_number.description: Camera serial number; preserve as text. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.

objective_model.description: Objective identifier/model recorded in metadata. Null when unavailable; do not infer from the selected imaging profile.

imaging_metadata_provenance.description: Per-field extraction provenance for imaging hardware/software fields. Include every such field, even when unknown. Metadata conflicts are retained and flagged for review.

source_reference.description: Dataset-relative source file path; null when unknown or directly user supplied.

metadata_key.description: Original vendor metadata key or field path.

raw_value.description: Original textual value before normalization; null if unavailable.
